label: MARKETING TERM
headline: A/B Testing
body: A/B testing is comparing two versions of something, like a webpage or an email, to see which one performs better with your audience.
caption:
Want to know if a blue button gets more clicks than a green one? Or if a different headline makes more people sign up? A/B testing helps you make smart choices based on real results, not just guesswork. It's a simple way to fine-tune your efforts and improve what you offer to your customers over time. Try testing one small change at a time to see what resonates most with your audience.
